read.thesis: Volumes grew 3% same-facility equivalent admissions (22nd straight quarter), but exchange-to-uninsured shift cost about $400M EBITDA; 2027 EBITDA guided roughly flat on a $550–650M Medicaid supplemental payment headwind.

utilisation.quote: We are running the company at an all time high when it comes to occupancy levels, pushing 75% on our inpatient platform.

capex.quote: Capital expenditures totaled approximately $1.36 billion in the quarter.

triggers.label: 2027 EBITDA roughly flat vs 2026
triggers.quote: we anticipate our earnings in 2027 will be generally consistent with 2026

triggers.label: Uninsured share 10.5% vs 8.5%
triggers.quote: Our uninsured volume in third quarter 26 represented approximately 10.5% of total equivalent admissions

guidance.quote: expected to be in the upper half of the $77 billion to $79.5 billion range
anticipated in the upper half of the $15.4 billion to $16.1 billion range

guidance.metric: FY2026 Medicaid supplemental payment net benefit
guidance.quote: We now expect the incremental net benefit from Medicaid supplemental payment programs to be between $600 million and $800 million. For the full year 2026.
we expect demand for services to remain strong with volume growth forecasted to be 2% to 3%
we anticipate our earnings in 2027 will be generally consistent with 2026

prior_guidance_check.quote: we are reaffirming our estimated guidance ranges for 2026
The third quarter would be 15% to 16% decline. Ended up at about 19% decline

red_flags.label: Exchange-to-uninsured shift; uninsured 10.5% of admissions
red_flags.quote: Our uninsured volume in third quarter 26 represented approximately 10.5% of total equivalent admissions

red_flags.label: Surgical volumes declining
red_flags.quote: 1.4% decline in same facility inpatient surgeries and 3.7% decline in same facility outpatient surgeries

evasions.quote: we are not quite ready to size it in terms of earnings impact
We are not sizing that publicly at this point.
